sections.title: The letter ü
paragraphs: The letter is called (ü) /y/. It has one sound, a short vowel. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear it in (üveg) /ˈyvɛɡ/, which means glass, bottle.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Push your tongue high and forward in your mouth. Bring your lips together into a small tight circle. Voice is on, so your throat shakes. Place a finger across your lips to feel the small round circle.

sections.title: Reading and spelling
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same sound in every word. You hear it at the start in (üveg) /ˈyvɛɡ/. You also hear it inside words.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not say the vowel sound in the English word boot. Pull your lips round, but push your tongue high forward as if saying see.
